scope: Chromium/Electron Linux+Windows GN graph only; standalone upstream builds not claimed. Nested Gitlink pins are preserved as identities and explicitly reviewed; differently pinned root dependencies are never represented as the nested pin being collected.

gitlinks.explanation: The pinned ANGLE GN wrapper defines only the rapidjson header source_set and its include configuration. It does not invoke upstream RapidJSON CMake or the test directory; the nested GoogleTest checkout is consumed by the separately retained upstream test/CMakeLists.txt.
Chromium crc32c_benchmark explicitly depends on //third_party/google_benchmark. The independently DEPS-selected root Benchmark source replaces the nested standalone CMake benchmark checkout.

Chromium crc32c_config defines CRC32C_TESTS_BUILT_WITH_GLOG=0 for the library and tests, and its explicit GN dependencies contain no glog target. Upstream CMake adds the nested glog checkout only under CRC32C_USE_GLOG for its standalone test/benchmark configuration.

Chromium crc32c_tests explicitly depends on //testing/gtest:gtest_main and //third_party/googletest:gtest. The independently DEPS-selected root GoogleTest source replaces the nested standalone CMake test checkout.

Chromium leveldb_db_bench_log explicitly depends on //third_party/google_benchmark. The DEPS-selected root Benchmark source is included; upstream CMake uses the distinct nested gitlink only for its standalone LEVELDB_BUILD_BENCHMARKS branch.

Chromium leveldb_testutil explicitly uses //third_party/googletest:gmock and :gtest (other tests use //testing/gtest). The DEPS-selected root GoogleTest source is included; upstream CMake uses the distinct nested gitlink only for standalone LEVELDB_BUILD_TESTS.

The exact Chromium BUILD.gn imports //tools/grit/grit_rule.gni and builds its own strings target from Chromium resource inputs. The 261 logical entries under src/tools/grit are retained in the full, verified Chromium source archive, rather than using libaddressinput externals/grit.

The util target compiles Chromium chromium/json.cc instead of upstream cpp/src/util/json.cc. The Chromium implementation uses base::JSONReader; the upstream file that includes rapidjson/document.h is not in the GN source list.

Chromium GN selects root //third_party/abseil-cpp source/generated-code targets. The matching source/header tree at src/third_party/abseil-cpp is vendored in the complete Chromium root archive; the accepted representative header ownership/hash is recorded separately. This standalone nested Gitlink revision is not selected.

Standalone upstream build-tool Gitlink. Chromium Nearby wrapper imports Chromium root build/protobuf GN files, selects src source/proto paths and root dependencies, and has no reference to nested depot_tools. Selected local source/include closure contains no depot_tools reference; upstream standalone build/tool execution is outside this scope.

Standalone Apple helper Gitlink. Chromium Nearby wrapper selects its listed source/proto files and Chromium root dependencies; no nested Google Toolbox for Mac path or header appears in this wrapper or selected local include closure. The scope is Linux/Windows Chromium GN, not upstream Apple builds.

Chromium Nearby BUILD.gn selects Chromium root //third_party/googletest targets/include roots, whose wrapper selects the separately pinned top-level DEPS checkout; it does not select this standalone Nearby nested Gitlink revision.

The standalone preferences API includes nlohmann/json_fwd.hpp. Its edge from selected platform.h is under #ifndef NEARBY_CHROMIUM. Every GN source_set selecting Nearby src files applies nearby_defines with NEARBY_CHROMIUM=1; recursive static header inspection excludes that edge and finds no active JSON include. The nested JSON Gitlink is not selected by this GN graph.

Chromium GN selects root //third_party/protobuf source/generated-code targets. The matching source/header tree at src/third_party/protobuf is vendored in the complete Chromium root archive; the accepted representative header ownership/hash is recorded separately. This standalone nested Gitlink revision is not selected.

Nearby selects Chromium root //third_party/ukey2, whose public_deps and proto imports select root //third_party/securemessage. Both wrappers refer to their separately pinned DEPS checkout rather than Nearby nested Gitlinks.

Chromium Nearby BUILD.gn selects Chromium root //third_party/smhasher targets/include roots, whose wrapper selects the separately pinned top-level DEPS checkout; it does not select this standalone Nearby nested Gitlink revision.

Chromium Nearby BUILD.gn selects Chromium root //third_party/ukey2 targets/include roots, whose wrapper selects the separately pinned top-level DEPS checkout; it does not select this standalone Nearby nested Gitlink revision.

The Chromium Ruy GN wrapper imports root //third_party/cpuinfo/cpuinfo.gni and, when use_cpuinfo is enabled, depends explicitly on //third_party/cpuinfo. The independently DEPS-selected root Cpuinfo checkout is included in the companion. The standalone nested CMake submodule pin is not selected by this GN branch.

The retained Chromium Ruy GN wrapper declares library source sets and no GoogleTest target or nested test dependency. Upstream CMake references this nested checkout only in the nonminimal test branch.
